---
title: Send Soroban token payments
description: Send a smart contract token payment directly from Varial
---

Once you have added a Soroban token to your Varial wallet, you can now send a payment of that token directly from Varial.

1. On the Varial account screen, click `Send` under your balance.

2. Select your token from the list.

3. Enter a recipient public key. Click `Continue`.

4. Enter a token amount. To add a memo (optional), click `Memo`. Click `Review Send`.

5. Review the details of your payment. Click `Confirm`.
